the force exerted on the particles by the background flow can be expressed in a closed form, that the force exert ed on the particles by disturbed flow can be expressed approximately in a closed form for the case of a constant background flow, that the force on the particles due to disturbed flow can be calculated numerically for the case of an unsteady background flow, and that the force exertion on a particle due to the disturbed flow is a function of the background flow velocity and the particle velocity.

the force on a particle in an arbitrary unsteady Stokes flow can be calculated by the method of reflections and that the force on the particle in the case of a uniform background flow is given by the sum of the force exerted by the background flow and that exerted by the disturbed flow.
